title: Fantaisie
identity: Éditions Combre C05757 is Gérard Gasparian’s Fantaisie for soprano saxophone and piano. The assigned catalog lists only soprano saxophone; the publisher-distributor catalog and a French music-school federation syllabus independently confirm piano accompaniment. This is an evidence-backed instrumentation correction proposal, not a catalog edit.

evidence.claim: Official catalog result identifies G. Gasparian, Fantaisie, soprano saxophone and piano, C05757. Direct PDF opening returned HTTP 403; the catalog entry is supported by the official PDF search index and the separate FFEA syllabus.
evidence.source_name: Éditions Combre catalog hosted by Henry Lemoine

evidence.claim: French Federation of Music Schools 2022 syllabus places Fantaisie C05757 in a soprano saxophone Cycle III CEM repertoire list.
evidence.source_name: Fédération Française de l’Enseignement Artistique syllabus

evidence.claim: Retail listing identifies Combre C05757 as soprano saxophone with piano accompaniment and advertises a preview. The product page could not be opened in the web client, and the notation was not inspected.

review_focus: The syllabus documents Cycle III CEM use; this is a French institutional placement and not a SaxoBrain level. Review the score for soprano-specific range, breath planning and piano coordination.
collection_flag: French music-school syllabus lists the work in its Cycle III CEM soprano-saxophone repertoire.

score_links.description: Retailer page advertises a preview; its notation images were not opened or inspected.

gaps: Retail page advertises a preview, but it could not be opened (web cache miss) and the official catalog PDF returned HTTP 403; no notation was inspected.

proposed_corrections.reason: Combre catalog and French Federation syllabus identify the C05757 Fantaisie as a soprano saxophone work with piano accompaniment.
